text: In the global and civilizational split in games, Slavs and game designers are observed to split into subgroups and actively engage in cultural mixing to represent diversity. This behavior aims to showcase cultural uniqueness and promote cultural exchange, with a focus on representing the diversity within the Slavic cultural group. Additionally, the similarity in language and the distinctiveness of Slavic cultures contribute to this approach. This behavior is widely regarded as normative by a significant portion of the sampled population, reflecting a strong acceptance of the practice of cultural mixing and diversity representation within the gaming context.
